IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Deduplicates one logical execution within the same operation on this local La Pluma instance across normal process restarts. Records are retained for up to 24 hours and may be evicted sooner when the 500-terminal-run cap is exceeded. Active runs restored after a restart become interrupted and are not resumed.

schema.description: Client-generated key that identifies one logical execution request.

bearerAuth.description: Optional LA_PLUMA_TOKEN sent through the Authorization header.

laPlumaToken.name: X-La-Pluma-Token
laPlumaToken.description: Optional LA_PLUMA_TOKEN sent through the X-La-Pluma-Token header.

runId.description: Server-generated id for one Agent API execution.

Unauthorized.description: A configured LA_PLUMA_TOKEN was missing or invalid.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The operation conflicts with the current execution state.

UnprocessableEntity.description: The request was valid but the requested automation could not be completed.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The service cannot safely accept the operation until its required runtime state is available.
